<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning and Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Budget planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_OutlineObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Department outlines objectives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_OutlineObjectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutlineObjectives_DraftPlan</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Team drafts budget plan with estimates and justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutlineObjectives_DraftPlan</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DraftPlan_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DraftPlan_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Finance reviews budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentsDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsDecision" name="Are further adjustments needed?" default="Flow_NoFurtherAdjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentsDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoFurtherAdjustments</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustPlan" name="Adjust plan based on review feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustPlan_DocumentAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustPlan_DocumentAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentAdjustment_StakeholderApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StakeholderApproval" name="Obtain stakeholder approval for adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentAdjustment_StakeholderApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget version">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoFurtherAdjustments</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalApproval_AllocateBudget</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalApproval_AllocateBudget</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllocateBudget_DistributeBudget</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllocateBudget_DistributeBudget</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DistributeBudget_BeginImplementation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Department begins implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DistributeBudget_BeginImplementation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeginImplementation_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed" name="Budget distributed and implementation begins">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeginImplementation_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OutlineObjectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutlineObjectives_DraftPlan" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DraftPlan_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentsDecision" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsDecision" targetRef="Task_AdjustPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustPlan_DocumentAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_AdjustPlan" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentAdjustment_StakeholderApproval" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StakeholderApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_StakeholderApproval" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFurtherAdjustments" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_AllocateBudget" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllocateBudget_DistributeBudget" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeBudget_BeginImplementation" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeginImplementation_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
